note: Hand-curated, sourced entries. Senate only: Delaware has no 2026 governor race (Gov. Matt Meyer was elected in 2024).

DE-senate.statusNote: Primaries are September 15, 2026, so nominees are not final. Sen. Chris Coons (D) is seeking re-election and is the clear Democratic frontrunner ($5.77M raised, token opposition). Army War College instructor John Shulli leads the Republican money race ($100K raised) in a field that also includes Michael Katz and Dexter Bland.

candidates.name: Chris Coons
candidates.background: U.S. Senator since winning a 2010 special election; previously New Castle County Executive and County Council president. Holds Yale law and divinity degrees and worked as a nonprofit executive and attorney. Senior member of the Judiciary, Appropriations, and Foreign Relations committees, running for re-election in 2026.
priorities: Protect the Affordable Care Act and Medicaid
Lower everyday costs, including ending cost-spiking tariffs
Clean energy and climate solutions for the lowest-lying state

cost.label: Voted for the Inflation Reduction Act, which capped insulin at $35 and let Medicare negotiate drug prices, passed 51-50 (Senate roll call 325, Aug 7, 2022)

health.label: 'Fought against Trump's threats to the Affordable Care Act and Medicaid'; supports universal access to quality healthcare (campaign priorities)

housing.label: 'Secured over $100 million in federal funds to invest in affordable housing initiatives across Delaware' (campaign priorities)

immigration.label: Voted no on the Laken Riley Act's mandatory-detention expansion, S. 5 passed 64-35 (Senate roll call 7, Jan 20, 2025)

taxes.label: Voted against final passage of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, agreed to 51-48 (Senate roll call 323, Dec 20, 2017)

climate.label: Backs 'new clean energy technologies to reduce and eventually replace our reliance on fossil fuels'; 'a tireless advocate for climate solutions' (campaign priorities)

education.label: Co-introduced the Strong Start for America's Children Act funding preschool for lower-income 4-year-olds: every child deserves 'the opportunity for a strong start' (Senate office)

safety.label: Co-led the bipartisan Begin Again Act expanding federal expungement: 'No one should be defined by a single one of their mistakes' (Senate office)

repro.label: Voted to advance the Women's Health Protection Act codifying abortion access, cloture failed 49-51 (Senate roll call 170, May 11, 2022)

democracy.label: Backed the Freedom to Vote Act and John Lewis Act and a filibuster carve-out to pass them: 'voting is a moral question' (Senate floor, Jan 19, 2022)

candidates.name: John Shulli
candidates.now: U.S. Army War College instructor; Army Reserve colonel
candidates.background: Delaware native and U.S. Army Reserve colonel with more than 29 years of service, now an instructor at the U.S. Army War College; previously worked in the Pentagon's Chief Digital and AI Office. First-time candidate who leads the Republican primary field in fundraising ahead of the September 15 primary.
priorities: Energy independence, including small modular nuclear reactors
Make Delaware 'the jobs factory of the 21st century'

cost.label: 'Stabilize the dollar and slash energy regulations to naturally drive down borrowing costs and interest rates for working families' (campaign platform)

health.label: 'Allocate health care funding directly to Americans, not to insurance companies'; mandate price transparency for all medical services and drugs (campaign platform)

housing.label: Cut 'federal HUD red tape and environmental regulations (NEPA) that drive up local construction costs for Delaware builders' (campaign platform)

immigration.label: 'Enforce aggressive deportation operations, secure the border' (campaign platform)

taxes.label: 'Eliminate the federal estate tax to preserve family wealth' plus new federal deductions for Delaware homeowners (campaign platform)

climate.label: 'Unleash American oil, natural gas, and coal (Drill, Baby, Drill)' alongside a Manhattan-style energy program and small modular reactors (campaign platform)

education.label: 'Close the Federal Department of Education and return control and tax dollars to the States'; bar federal interference in local curricula (campaign platform)

safety.label: 'Deploy federal RICO charges to shatter gang violence' and invoke the Alien Enemies Act of 1798 against transnational gangs (campaign platform)

democracy.label: 'All voters must show photo ID, proof of citizenship'; no mail-in ballots except for illness, disability, military, or travel (campaign platform)
